mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) over the past 3 months compresses discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in < 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS declines over the past 3 months, or the Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the federal funds rate above 0.5% per annum signals a shift to monetary tightening, compressing equity valuations and leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in < 40% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 0.5%, or the Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent rise in industrial production (INDPRO) and housing starts (HOUST) signals robust economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO and HOUST both rise > 0.5% in the past month
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in < 60% of instances where INDPRO and HOUST both rise > 0.5% in the past month, or the Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles (defined by FEDFUNDS rising above 0.2% and sustained for 3 months), the S&P 500 underperforms, leading to negative forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in < 40% of instances during monetary tightening cycles (as defined by FEDFUNDS > 0.2% and rising for 3 months), or the Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) over the past 3 months signals improving labor market conditions, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in < 60% of instances where UNRATE declines over the past 3 months, or the Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate above 8.0% signals a weak labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in < 40% of instances where UNRATE > 8.0%, or the Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent rise in real GDP (GDPC1) and real personal consumption (RSAFS) signals strong economic demand, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 and RSAFS both rise > 0.5% in the past quarter
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in < 60% of instances where GDPC1 and RSAFS both rise > 0.5% in the past quarter, or the Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansion (defined by INDPRO above 100 and rising for 3 months), the S&P 500 underperforms, leading to negative forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in < 40% of instances during late-cycle expansion (as defined by INDPRO > 100 and rising for 3 months), or the Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
